chunks: Ḥasan ibn ‘Abdillāh narrated to me from his father ‘Abdillāh ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from Dāwūd Al-Ṣarmī, from Abā Ja’far the Second (peace be upon him), who said:
I heard him say: Whoever visits the grave of my father, for him is Paradise.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the grave of Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Rida?
ai.summary: In *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, Ibn Qulawayh records this concise yet profound tradition from Imam al-Jawad (a.s.), linking the physical act of visiting the shrine of Imam al-Rida in Tus directly to the ultimate reward of Paradise. This narration underscores the Shia theological emphasis on the intercessory status of the Imams and the spiritual merit attached to honoring their resting places, a practice deeply rooted in early Kufan and Tus scholarly circles.
